stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of energies in 1 mole of a gas. The gas can take part in a reaction with an activation energy, $E_\text{a}$.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution graph: proportion of molecules with a given energy against molecular energy, with peak P and activation energy E_a marked on the energy axis.

stem.text: Which statement correctly describes the effect of an increase in temperature?

A.text: Peak P will be higher and fewer molecules will have energy $> E_\text{a}$.

B.text: Peak P will be higher and more molecules will have energy $> E_\text{a}$.

C.text: Peak P will be lower and fewer molecules will have energy $> E_\text{a}$.

D.text: Peak P will be lower and more molecules will have energy $> E_\text{a}$.
